description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Bam Knight (concussion) was absent from Arizona's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Knight is still going through the NFL's concussion protocols and was unable to practice on Wednesday as a result. That doesn't bode well for his Week 9 availability, and Tyler Allgeier is primed to be the team's undisputed RB1 on Sunday if Knight is ruled out ahead of game time.
items.title: Bam Knight (concussion) absent from practice Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Michael Wilson (rest/ribs) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Wilson suffered an injury to his ribs in Week 8 and was limited at Wednesday's practice as a result. It looks like he will be ready to play in time for Sunday, but fantasy managers should continue to monitor his status throughout the week to confirm that he will be good to go against the Seahawks.
items.title: Michael Wilson (rest/ribs) limited at practice Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Deshaun Watson (concussion) officially did not practice for the Browns on Wednesday.
items.impact: Watson was placed in the NFL's concussion protocol on Wednesday, so it's not at all surprising that he was a non-participant at practice. It looks all but guaranteed that he will be sidelined this week, which will leave Shedeur Sanders as the starting quarterback for the Browns in his absence. That would be a somewhat lateral move for Cleveland's fantasy-relevant pass catchers.
items.title: Deshaun Watson (concussion) officially doesn't practice Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Jared Verse (knee) was listed as a limited participant on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was a limited participant at Wednesday's practice. He's currently battling a knee issue, but he was able to play through it last week and is likely to do the same again in Week 9.
items.title: Jared Verse (knee) listed as limited Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Elgton Jenkins (knee) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was limited on Wednesday, which comes as no surprise, as the team has made a habit of limiting his workload at practice throughout the year so far. He should play on Sunday, barring any setbacks.
items.title: Elgton Jenkins (knee) limited Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Austin Barber (calf) was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Barber is managing a calf injury of some kind right now and was unable to practice on Wednesday as a result. It could threaten his availability for Week 9, which would be bad news for Cleveland's offensive front ahead of a matchup against the Saints this week.
items.title: Austin Barber (calf) a non-participant Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Denzel Boston (calf) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie was a limited participant on Wednesday. He's managing a calf issue right now, but it doesn't seem to be serious enough to threaten his availability for Week 9. If active on Sunday, his target share may look different with Shedeur Sanders set to be the starting quarterback for the Browns.
items.title: Denzel Boston (calf) limited at practice Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) missed New Orleans' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran wasn't able to practice on Wednesday. He's managing a back issue right now, and the team also wanted to give him the day off for load management purposes. His participation at Thursday's practice should be much more revealing for his Week 9 availability.
items.title: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: CJ Donaldson (shoulder/concussion) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Donaldson was limited at practice on Wednesday as he continues to recover from a pair of issues that he's dealing with. He may be sidelined in Week 9 as a result, which would lead to more work for Kendre Miller in a matchup against the Browns this week.
items.title: CJ Donaldson (shoulder/concussion) limited Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Mason Taylor (back) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Taylor's back injury left him limited at practice on Wednesday. It doesn't seem to be a serious issue at this point, however, so it looks likely that he will play and see his usual workload against the Chiefs this week.
items.title: Mason Taylor (back) limited at practice Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: David Bailey (groin) was considered a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bailey was sidelined in Week 8 while dealing with a groin issue, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday and seems to be on track to play on Sunday. New York's defensive front will be close to full strength once again if he's available to play this week.
items.title: David Bailey (groin) considered limited Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Garrett Wilson (concussion) did not take part in New York's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Wilson was recently placed in the NFL's concussion protocols and wasn't able to practice on Wednesday as a result. It looks like a long shot that he will be cleared to play in time for Sunday's game, and if he's ruled out, Adonai Mitchell and Omar Cooper Jr. should both see a substantial increase in opportunities in his absence.
items.title: Garrett Wilson (concussion) doesn't practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Raiders released WR Cody White.
items.impact: White has hauled in three touchdowns this season. He has also played a role on special teams.
items.title: Cody White released by Raiders

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Breece Hall (quad) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: As expected, Hall was a limited participant to start the week on Wednesday. He seems to be very close to a return from his quad injury, but there also remains a slight chance that he will be traded in the near future, so fantasy managers should continue to monitor his status closely throughout the rest of the week to see if he will play in Week 9.
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) limited at practice Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Rice is dealing with a pair of injuries right now and was limited at practice on Wednesday as a result. He should still be available to play in Week 9, but we won't get an official injury decision for him until later on in the week.
items.title: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) limited at practice Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Delane was sidelined last week while recovering from a shoulder issue. He was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, however, which puts him on track to play in Week 9. Kansas City's secondary will get a nice boost if he's back in the lineup this week.
items.title: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) limited participant Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jordan Whittington will be limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Whittington remains off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Jordan Whittington (back) practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Steve Avila will be limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Avila remains up in the air heading into Week 9.
items.title: Steve Avila (hamstring) practicing Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Travis Kelce (ankle) was limited at Kansas City's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was limited for the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday. He's still managing an ankle issue of some kind, but it isn't likely to leave him sidelined in Week 9. He will continue to be a decently safe PPR option on a week-to-week basis moving forward.
items.title: Travis Kelce (ankle) limited at practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Grant Stuard will be limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Stuard was considered week-to-week to begin the week.
items.title: Grant Stuard (hamstring) practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Joe Cardona is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Cardona is working his way through an ankle injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: Joe Cardona (ankle) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kam Curl is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Curl is working his way through a foot injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: Kam Curl (foot) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Colby Parkinson is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Parkinson did not play in last Sunday's win over the Chargers. His status for Week 9 remains up in the air.
items.title: Colby Parkinson (ribs) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Trent McDuffie is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: McDuffie is continuing to work his way through a back injury. His status heading into Week 9 is uncertain.
items.title: Trent McDuffie (back) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Morgan Moses (foot) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Unsurprisingly, the veteran was limited at practice on Wednesday due to the same foot issue that has been bothering him for a while. He's likely to play through it in Week 9, however, which is good news for New England's offensive front.
items.title: Morgan Moses (foot) limited Wednesday
